why: The adapter executes the pinned Loreley checkout's own code, which needs that checkout's dependencies (pydantic, SQLAlchemy, psycopg, numpy). Those are installed into a copy of the pinned checkout at checkout/.venv; a harness that discovers '/usr/bin/python3 -m a0_adapter' cannot import 'loreley'.
bin/a0-loreley pins that interpreter absolutely and resolves its own paths relative to the file, so it works from any cwd and without PYTHONPATH.
A0_LORELEY_PYTHON overrides the interpreter; A0_LORELEY_REEXECUTED=1 suppresses the adapter's own re-exec fallback inside cli.main.
